command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('SZ_AR','PE3','PE2','PE1','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','FW_01','FW_02','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02'); foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { `$cmd=if (`$n -eq 'BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01') {'show%20running-config'} else {'display%20current-configuration'}; `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_04/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cmd; `$u2='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cmd; try { `$a=((Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1 -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n') | ForEach-Object { `$_.TrimEnd() }; `$b=((Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u2 -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n') | ForEach-Object { `$_.TrimEnd() }; Write-Output ('### '+`$n); Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$a -DifferenceObject `$b | Where-Object { `$_.InputObject -notmatch 'Last configuration|!Time:|Current configuration :|Statistics|Current system time|Last.*time|engineid|engineID|snmp-server user|certificate|quit|password|local-engineid|^\s*[0-9A-F]{8}\s|^!$|^#$|license udi' } | Select-Object InputObject,SideIndicator | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } catch { Write-Output ('ERR '+`$n) } }"
